headline: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics tools resolve niche-dependent gene co-expression
label: Transcriptomics Analysis Tools And Databases
summary: Expanding spatial and single-cell datasets demand context-aware methods and curated resources for regulatory inference.
synthesis: The dominant thread is gene co-expression and regulatory inference applied to single-cell and spatially resolved transcriptomes, increasingly evaluated within neighbourhoods and niches rather than globally. Benchmarking of clustering strategies for patient-specific GRNs (PANDA/LIONESS) across 9,778 tumors and Starlng's stability assessment of co-expression nests address robustness. NicheCorr and DiCoLo are new in targeting localized or niche-dependent differential co-expression without prior integration or clustering. Resources such as SpatialRegNet, STRAND, and Cell3D curate hundreds to thousands of datasets, while Spatialsnake unifies Visium, Visium HD, Stereo-seq, Xenium and MERFISH outputs. Not all items share this focus; CATFISHR, the CTCL atlas, and Multiplex-GCN address malignant cell identification and tumor microenvironment subtyping.
